name: Automotive Machine Inc
old_description: Automotive Machine Inc. has been serving the Great Falls and surrounding area for over 38 years.  Starting out by rebuilding engines in a small shop, Automotive Machine has grown and changed over the years, expanding to its current well-stocked Parts Department and Machine Shop on one side of the street – to a busy, high quality vehicle repair & service center on the other side of the street.
about:
Automotive Machine Inc. has served Great Falls, Montana, for over 38 years. The locally owned business began as a small engine-rebuilding shop and has since expanded across two locations on 25th Street North: a parts department and machine shop on one side, and a full-service vehicle repair center on the other.

The company operates a machine shop that provides engine rebuilding, torque-plate boring, crank indexing, crank stroking, magnafluxing, welding, valve jobs, and connecting-rod and flywheel service. It also supplies rebuilt engines with a two-year/24,000-mile warranty, runs a wholesale parts department stocking internal engine components, Sherwin-Williams automotive paint with custom mixing, and a growing performance and racing parts line. The service center handles brake work, drum and rotor service, and front and rear axle repair.

Customers include professional mechanics, DIY engine builders, and performance racing teams working on foreign, domestic, and high-performance vehicles. The parts department serves both trade and retail buyers, while the machine shop and service center handle passenger cars and light-duty trucks.

The company emphasizes fully guaranteed parts and services, nationwide shipping, and flexible payment options. It was founded to provide quality machine work and engine rebuilding to the Great Falls area.
